Presented “R&D Employment Spillovers in Trade and MNE Networks”, joint with Magnus Tolum Buus, Jakob Roland Munch and Georg Schaur, at the [OECD LIFT workshop](https://www.oecd.org/en/about/projects/leveraging-inter-firm-transactions.html) in Paris. LIFT (Leveraging Inter-Firm Transactions) is the OECD network on firm-to-firm data.
